title: Sqays Hub
features:
Mining Automation

Select any combination of ores (Stone → Infinity)

Auto-mine with smooth tweening

Auto-exchange minerals at set intervals (1–60 minutes)

Combat Automation

Choose from 12+ mob types (Goblin → Ancient Boss)

Auto-farm selected mobs with configurable speed

Dedicated Ancient Boss farm (auto-summon + kill)

Ritual automation (summon altar, fight ritual mobs, configurable cooldown)

Trials (Hard/Medium/Easy)

Auto-join based on live countdown (monitors portal timer)

Auto-leave at user-defined wave (1–100)

Auto-return to captured position after leaving

Nearest mob farm inside trial rooms

Live countdown display & notifications

Realm 3 Upgrades

Noob upgrades 

Sand, Souls, Bones, Meat upgrade categories (all toggleable)

Auto-deposit meat (hourly or at % capacity)

Auto-back-to-surface (returns when below a layer)

Auto-shovel level up with adjustable interval

Auto-open trial chests (T2 → T1 cycling)

Realm 4 Upgrades

Star Collection 

Chip Farm – auto-collect chips + auto-merge 

Auto Research – starts cheapest/available research with slot management

UFO Upgrade – auto-upgrade to max

Upgrade Board Visits – visits boards only when affordable 

Individual planet upgrades (Mercury → Neptune)

Noob upgrades (Alien, Demon, Astronaut)

Upgrade categories: Stars, SpacePoints, Planets, Moon, Blackholes, AlienCash, Knowledge, Chips

Enchant System

Auto-roll enchantments for any Noob (Starter → Astronaut)

Skip “Almighty” enchant option per Noob

Configurable roll interval (0.01–1s)

Rune Farming

Auto-sit at selected rune (supports all rune locations across realms)

Automatically teleports to the correct realm

Capsule Opening

Auto-open selected capsule type (Ancient, Classic, Football, Super, Cosmic)

Configurable open interval

Hacker Area

HackPoints upgrade category (8 upgrades) with auto-buy

Quality of Life

Anti-AFK (prevents server idle kick)

Animation Hider – hides capsule & chest animations (reduces visual clutter)

FPS Optimizer – caps at 60 FPS (auto-reduces to 30 when tabbed out)

Redeem All Codes – one-click redeem of 25+ active codes

Open Game UIs – Expeditions, Enchants, Sword Enchants, Rune Sacrifice
